## File type

Which file type does this apply to?

Examples: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, MP3, MP4, MOV, WebP

## Metadata field

What metadata field should be added?

Example: GPS latitude and longitude, Author, Creator, Producer, Last Modified By, Company, Encoder

## Why it matters

What privacy, identity, location, company, or workflow information can this field reveal?

## Source or reference

If possible, include a reference, documentation link, tool output, or example.

## Suggested checklist text

How should this be written in the checklist?
